film.name: film
film.textSnippet: Watch this film on your own computer. It has no sound, so every word you need is written on the screen. It comes in three parts. The three buttons under the film take you straight to any part.

console.name: console

plan.name: plan

plan.contentAnchor: So far you have built bots with most of the words already written for you. This one is yours: you choose what it asks, and you write every word it says. Watch the two-minute film first. It shows the two things people get stuck on — picking questions that are easy to answer, and writing a last line that uses both answers at once.
plan.cardText: YOUR BOT · You have twelve minutes to build one bot, in your own words. · So far you have built bots with most of the words already written for you. bench.name: bench
bench.textSnippet: Not sure where to start? Press the button below and the whole shape drops into your program. The sentences are still yours to write.
bench.contentAnchor: Not sure where to start? Press the button below and the whole shape drops into your program. The sentences are still yours to write.
bench.cardText: Write a chatbot that asks TWO questions and uses both answers. · WHAT YOUR BOT HAS TO DO · 1NOT CHECKED YET · Your bot asks two questions. · 2NOT CHECKED YET · It keeps each answer in its own box (its own variable). · 3NOT CHECKED YET · Its last line uses both answers. · YOUR BOT · 1 line · 1 · Not sure where to start? wait.name: wait
wait.textSnippet: You are in the queue. The website is waiting for somebody else in your class to finish their bot. The moment one does, the two of you become partners and this screen changes by itself. Nothing is wron
wait.contentAnchor: You are in the queue. The website is waiting for somebody else in your class to finish their bot. The moment one does, the two of you become partners and this screen changes by itself. Nothing is wrong: stay on this screen.
wait.cardText: Waiting for a partner. · You are in the queue. The website is waiting for somebody else in your class to finish their bot. The moment one does, the two of you become partners and this screen changes by itself. Nothing is wrong: stay on this screen. · FRED · Right, this waiting's a bit awkward, and I don't like silence. matched.name: matched
matched.textSnippet: You are not told who they really are until the Swap is finished. So do not type anybody's real name here, not even your own. Your teacher can read every message that goes between you.
matched.contentAnchor: You are not told who they really are until the Swap is finished. So do not type anybody's real name here, not even your own. Your teacher can read every message that goes between you.
matched.cardText: PARTNER FOUND · You have a partner. · Your partner for the Swap is Pliers 2. They are at another computer in this room, and they have just finished a bot too. · On their screen, you are Hammer 5. · You are not told who they really are until the Swap is finished. So do not type anybody's real name here, not even your own. Your teacher can read every message that goes between you. · You test their bot, they test yours, and you each write the other a short report. · Start the Swap
